WITH h AS (SELECT customer_id,article_id,days_ago,product_type_no,section_no,garment_group_no,cutoff FROM train_history), p AS (SELECT customer_id,article_id,label,timestamp,raw_i_product_type_no,raw_i_section_no,raw_i_garment_group_no FROM train_pairs), x AS (SELECT p.label, MIN(h.days_ago) AS rec, MAX(CASE WHEN h.product_type_no=p.raw_i_product_type_no THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS typ, MAX(CASE WHEN h.section_no=p.raw_i_section_no THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sec, MAX(CASE WHEN h.garment_group_no=p.raw_i_garment_group_no THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gar FROM p LEFT JOIN h ON h.customer_id=p.customer_id AND h.cutoff=p.timestamp GROUP BY p.label,p.customer_id,p.article_id,p.timestamp,p.raw_i_product_type_no,p.raw_i_section_no,p.raw_i_garment_group_no) SELECT label, COUNT(*) n, AVG(CASE WHEN rec IS NOT NULL AND rec<=30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) rec30, AVG(typ),AVG(sec),AVG(gar),AVG(CASE WHEN rec IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) has_hist FROM x GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
